description: This file contains tests for the 'delivery-dispatch' module, specifically testing the 'matchesMessagingToolDeliveryTarget' function and 'resolveCronDeliveryBestEffort' function, using the Vitest testing framework. It mocks dependencies and verifies matching behavior and configuration options.

methods.name: matchesMessagingToolDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Determines if a messaging target matches given delivery details, considering channel, recipient, provider, and optional account IDs.

methods.name: resolveCronDeliveryBestEffort
methods.description: Determines whether a cron job delivery should be marked as 'best effort' based on its configuration.

ctags.name: job
ctags.pattern: /^    const job = { delivery: { bestEffort: true }, payload: { kind: "agentTurn" } } as never;$/

ctags.name: job
ctags.pattern: /^    const job = { delivery: {}, payload: { kind: "agentTurn" } } as never;$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const job = { delivery: { bestEffort: true }, payload: { kind: "agentTurn" } } as never;$/
